text.Política de Privacidad y tratamiento de: Privacy Policy and personal data processing of COZZE MINERIA SpA.
text.En COZZE MINERIA SpA respetamos la priva: At COZZE MINERIA SpA we respect the privacy of the people who visit this website and contact us through it. This Policy explains what personal data we collect, what we use it for and how you can exercise your rights, in accordance with Chilean Law No. 19,628 on the Protection of Private Life and its amendments, including Law No. 21,719.
text.Solo recopilamos los datos que tú nos en: We only collect the data you voluntarily provide through the contact form:
text.Perfil (por ejemplo, productor o comprad: Profile (for example, producer or buyer) and the content of your message
text.No solicitamos datos sensibles. Te pedim: We do not request sensitive data. Please do not include it in your message.
text.Además, como ocurre con cualquier sitio: In addition, as with any website, the hosting provider automatically records technical data about the visit (such as IP address, browser type and date and time of access) for security purposes and to operate the service.
text.Usamos tus datos exclusivamente para:: We use your data exclusively to:
text.Responder tus consultas y solicitudes de: Respond to your inquiries and requests for information.
text.Evaluar y gestionar solicitudes de maqui: Assess and manage requests for toll processing, ore purchase or sale of concentrates.
text.Mantener comunicaciones relacionadas con: Maintain communications related to your request or to an existing business relationship.
text.No vendemos ni arrendamos tus datos, y n: We do not sell or rent your data, and we will not send you advertising without your prior consent.
text.Tratamos tus datos sobre la base de tu c: We process your data on the basis of your consent, which you give by ticking the acceptance box on the form, and, where applicable, to carry out pre-contractual or contractual measures that you request. You may withdraw your consent at any time, without retroactive effect.
text.5. Comunicación de datos a terceros: 5. Disclosure of data to third parties
text.No compartimos tus datos con terceros, s: We do not share your data with third parties, except:
text.Proveedores tecnológicos que nos prestan: Technology providers that supply services necessary to operate this website (for example, web hosting), acting on our behalf and solely for that purpose. Some of them may store data on servers located outside Chile, applying adequate security measures.
text.Autoridades públicas, cuando exista una: Public authorities, when there is a legal obligation or a court order.
text.Conservamos tus datos durante el tiempo: We keep your data for as long as necessary to handle your inquiry and, at most, up to 24 months from our last contact, unless there is an ongoing business relationship or a legal obligation (for example, tax-related) that requires us to keep it longer. Once this period has ended, we delete or anonymize it.
text.Aplicamos medidas técnicas y organizativ: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data against loss, unauthorized access, alteration or disclosure. Access to it is restricted to the staff who need it to handle your request.
text.Como titular de los datos, puedes ejerce: As the data subject, you may exercise the following rights at any time:
to know what data about you we process.
to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
to request that we delete your data.
to object to a specific processing.
text.recibir tus datos en un formato estructu: to receive your data in a structured, commonly used format.
text.solicitar la suspensión temporal del tra: to request the temporary suspension of processing.
text.con el asunto «Datos personales», indica: with the subject “Personal data”, stating your name, the right you wish to exercise and a means for us to reply to you. We may ask you for documentation to verify your identity. We will respond within the time limits established by law.
text.Si consideras que no hemos atendido adec: If you believe that we have not properly handled your request, you may refer the matter to the Chilean Personal Data Protection Agency (Agencia de Protección de Datos Personales) or to the competent courts.
text.Este sitio no utiliza cookies propias de: This website does not use its own tracking or advertising cookies. To display the site’s typography, fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may mean that your browser shares technical data (such as your IP address) with Google. Links to Google Maps are governed by Google’s privacy policies.
text.Este sitio está dirigido a productores m: This website is intended for mining producers, companies and buyers. We do not knowingly collect data from persons under 18 years of age.
text.Podemos actualizar esta Política para re: We may update this Policy to reflect legal changes or changes to our services. We will publish the current version on this page, indicating the date of its last update.
